name: speedygo-dev-checkout-preview
purpose: Synthetic active DeliveryZone + DeliveryPricingRule so Customer Checkout preview can succeed on speedygo_dev. Test amounts only — not production pricing. Optional companion GLOBAL_DEFAULT merchant commission enables Order creation (preview does not require it).

namespace.idempotency: Stable synthetic admin + permission seed via INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Zone/rule created once via audited Admin API and reused by exact fixture names. Never deactivates unrelated zones/rules. Commission companion uses INSERT … WHERE NOT EXISTS an active open GLOBAL_DEFAULT.
doesNotOwn: live customer accounts except synthetic admin actor

syntheticAdmin.note: Synthetic only. No privileges granted to real users. changed_by_admin_id for the commission companion row.

address.label: Revue checkout Hydra
address.note: Customer delivery address used by live Revue checkout preview.

alsoCovers.note: Checkout zone resolution uses the owned delivery address, not the branch pin.

coverage.geoJsonOrder: [longitude, latitude] SRID 4326 Polygon, closed ring, no holes

pricingRule.name: SpeedyGo Dev Revue Hydra All-Day

customerDeliveryFeeMinor.role: Customer-facing delivery fee returned by checkout preview

driverRemunerationMinor.role: Required driver remuneration field on the pricing rule (not shown on customer preview)

pricingRule.consistency: Matches common checkout E2E fixture pair fee=500 / remun=300 and customer_app mock preview deliveryFeeMinor=500.

merchantCommissionCompanion.ownership: Companion to checkout fixtures for Order creation only. Owned by this fixture namespace on speedygo_dev. Not created by Admin commission HTTP (none in this phase). Inserted as SQL data when no active open GLOBAL_DEFAULT exists. Script: seed-commission-companion.sql
merchantCommissionCompanion.why: POST /customer/orders resolves merchant commission inside the create transaction; Checkout preview does not. Empty commission table yields ORDER_FINANCIAL_CONFIGURATION_INVALID.
merchantCommissionCompanion.safeRerun: INSERT … SELECT … WHERE NOT EXISTS (active GLOBAL_DEFAULT with effective_to IS NULL). Never updates, deactivates, or deletes unrelated commission rows. Does not change rate formulas in application code.

creationPath: Permissioned Admin API POST /admin/delivery/zones + activate, POST /admin/delivery/pricing-rules + activate (audited). Commission companion: idempotent SQL seed-commission-companion.sql
